title: AI Programming Tools Are Getting Stronger, Why Do Few Domestic Developers Still Find Them Difficult to Use?

content_html:
Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI are rapidly changing the way developers work.

Tasks that used to take hours, such as code debugging, project refactoring, and feature development, can now be handled by AI programming agents just by describing the requirements. These agents can read code repositories, modify files, execute commands, and assist with debugging.

However, for many domestic developers, the real issue affecting their experience is not whether the model is smart enough, but a set of more practical problems:

  • Unstable network connection, causing tasks to be interrupted halfway;

  • Complex payment and recharge processes on overseas platforms;

  • High configuration threshold for models and tools;

  • Difficulties in managing team quotas and usage;

  • Enterprise procurement requires contracts, invoices, and after-sales support.

This is especially true when dealing with large codebases, long-running agent tasks, or high-concurrency team calls. A single connection interruption could lead to the task needing to be restarted. Even if the model's capabilities are strong, it's hard to truly integrate into daily development workflows without stable access.

Integrate AI programming tools into the development workflow

AICodeMirror addresses these issues by providing a highly stable intermediate service for mainstream AI programming tools such as Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, targeting individual developers, independent creators, university research teams, and enterprise R&D organizations.

Developers no longer need to repeatedly deal with complex cross-border network and payment issues, and can easily integrate the relevant tools into their daily development environment for use in:

  • Generating front-end and back-end code based on natural language requirements;

  • Analyzing large projects and identifying potential defects;

  • Refactoring and optimizing legacy code;

  • Calling AI within VS Code, JetBrains, and command-line workflows;

  • Allocating quotas and managing usage for team members;

  • Supporting centralized procurement for university laboratories and enterprise R&D teams.

The platform continuously tracks updates to mainstream models and currently supports models such as Claude Fable5.1, Claude Opus5-5, Claude Fable5, Claude Sonnet5, GPT-6Astra, GPT-6-sol, and Gemini3.8Flash. Developers can choose flexibly based on needs such as complex reasoning, code generation, response speed, and cost control.

Stability is not the only concern; we also address payment and after-sales issues

For developers who need to use AI programming tools long-term, price, payment, and after-sales support are equally important.

AICodeMirror offers a PAYGO pay-as-you-go model with long-lasting balance, as well as monthly discount plans such as PRO, MAX, and ULTRA. The official channel for Codex is as low as 0.7 times the original price, and additional discounts are available when recharging.

At the same time, the platform provides:

  • Multipath network disaster recovery switching;

  • Enterprise-level high concurrency support;

  • 7×24-hour dedicated technical support;

  • Team seat and usage management;

  • Corporate contracts and compliant invoices;

  • Real-time service status query;

  • Refund support according to platform rules;

  • User-submitted business data is not stored.

Currently, AICodeMirror has served over 400 enterprises and universities, with more than 20,000 subscribers, and maintains a stable service of over 365 days.

New user experience benefits

Registering for AICodeMirror through a specified link now offers:

  • 8 yuan permanent quota upon registration;

  • 80% discount on first recharge;

  • Codex official channel as low as 0.7 times;

  • Contact 7×24-hour technical support for configuration and usage issues.

For developers who want to use Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI stably but don't want to repeatedly handle network, payment, and configuration issues, they can start with the free quota for actual testing and then choose between pay-as-you-go or monthly plans based on their usage.
